nodes.label: local-only Experiment Profile
nodes.rationale: Local without Ollama embeddings: sentence-transformers in-process plus a cross-encoder reranker. The default profile is already fully local via Ollama, so this profile exists specifically to exercise the second local embedding path and the reranker. Needs pip install -e '.[local]'.

nodes.label: BGE Asymmetric Query Prefix
nodes.rationale: bge is asymmetric: queries expect the instruction prefix 'Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages: ' while documents do not. Encoding both sides identically would degrade retrieval, so the prefix is a provider option rather than something business logic knows about.

nodes.label: 384-Dimension Database Separation
nodes.rationale: bge-small-en-v1.5 is 384-dimensional against nomic-embed-text's 768. The chunks table fixes its vector width at migration time, so this profile needs its own database (osc_local384) and a full re-index; it cannot share one with the default profile.

nodes.label: cross_encoder Reranker (ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2)
nodes.rationale: The only profile that enables reranking. It is the exercise path for the reranker seam that the default profile leaves as noop, and the configuration whose unbounded negative logits motivated moving min_score to first-stage scores.
